title: Final Surface Charge Density
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and present the expression for the induced surface charge density sigma(theta).

title: Explanation of Magnetic Field
description: Essential Criteria: The student must clearly explain why no magnetic field is produced when the sphere is rotated.

title: Use of Electric Field
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly reference the electric field inside the sphere and its relation to the polarization.

title: Polarization Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct calculation of the polarization vector p based on the electric field.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the expressions for charge density or polarization.

title: Sketch of Magnetic Field Lines
description: Optional Criteria: If applicable, the student may provide a sketch of magnetic field lines, even if no field is produced.
